summary: A <fieldset>/<legend> group of mutually exclusive options. Owns the shared name and the selected value.
useWhen: exactly one choice from a small set, all worth showing at once
the options need explaining — each one can carry its own label text

useInstead.when: the list is long, or space is tight
more than one may be picked
there are exactly two states and the change is immediate

neutral.use: a choice with no positive reading — sort order, display mode

danger.use: a set where the options are destructive

label.note: renders as the <legend> — the question the options answer

guarantees: a real fieldset rather than `role="radiogroup"`: both announce correctly, but the fieldset also groups the inputs for form submission and native validation
`name` is generated when omitted, so two groups on one page never collide
`isDisabled` cascades to every Radio that has not set its own
requires: `label`, or `aria-label` when the question is already visible elsewhere

antiPatterns.why: the options are announced with no question attached
controlled and uncontrolled at once; the controlled value wins and `defaultValue` silently does nothing

antiPatterns.dont: no option selected by default with no "none" option
antiPatterns.why: a radio group cannot be returned to empty once touched
